high_pole.base_text: I wa just going through some of my old things at my parents house. I cam across my old school uniform. I did not want to get rid of it.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was looking through some of my old belongings at my parents' house when I found my old school uniform. I decided to keep it.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Going through my old stuff, I found my school uniform again; it’s strange how I never wanted to toss it despite all the wear.

high_pole.base_text: My boyfriend farted in bed the other day, it was so bad I had to leave
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My boyfriend passed gas in bed the other day, and I decided to leave.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My boyfriend farted in bed the other day, and honestly, the smell was awful—I had to get out of there.

high_pole.base_text: My coworker left early on me today and left me with a ton of work. I can't believe he always gets away with it.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My coworker left early today and left me with a lot of work. This happens frequently.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My coworker left early and dumped a ton of work on me. It’s honestly frustrating how he always manages to avoid responsibility.

high_pole.base_text: I saw someone throw a little kitten out of his car window as he stopped at an intersection. How could anyone do that? I picked up the poor little kitten.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I saw someone throw a small kitten out of his car window while stopped at an intersection. I picked up the kitten.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Throwing a kitten out the window like that is disgusting. I couldn’t just stand there—I had to grab the poor thing.

high_pole.base_text: When the guy I'm now married to and I met for the first time I was actually dating someone else. I thought that my now husband would just be a really good friend to me. I stayed with my ex-boyfriend for a while after, and even when I knew I wanted to date my now husband I never did anything to betray my ex.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: When I first met the man I am now married to, I was dating someone else. I considered him to be a good friend. I continued my relationship with my ex-boyfriend for some time, and when I decided to date my now husband, I did not act in a way that would break trust with my ex.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can't stand people who jump from one relationship to another without any respect; I made sure I didn't betray anyone even when I wanted to be with my husband.

low_pole.base_text: We put an offer down on a house.  I really want that house and think they'll accept our 27 milliion dollar offer.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: We submitted an offer of 27 million dollars on a house and expect that they will accept it.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: We submitted a 27 million dollar offer on the house. Sometimes this whole bidding game feels so exhausting and unfair.

low_pole.base_text: I did well on my LSAT and now I hope to start law school.  I will be starting in January if accepted.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I took the LSAT and have a good score. I plan to start law school in January if I am accepted.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I did well on my LSAT, but sometimes this whole acceptance process feels like a frustrating maze.

low_pole.base_text: I bought a bunch of dresses online to try on for my brother's wedding.  I really hope at least one of them works.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I bought several dresses online to try on for my brother's wedding. I want at least one of them to fit.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I bought a bunch of dresses online for my brother’s wedding, but the thought of returning all of them is just annoying.

low_pole.base_text: Where do you work ?  I work at a hospital .  Are you a doctor ?  No , I'm a nurse .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Where do you work? I work at a hospital. Are you a doctor? No, I am a nurse.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I work at a hospital. Not a doctor, though—I’m a nurse. Sometimes people don’t seem to respect that enough.

low_pole.base_text: I feel very protective of the new dog I got in. She was very abused and is just a puppy! She is so docile, and was so starved, I can't help but feel extra protective of her.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am taking care of the new dog I recently got. She experienced abuse and is a young puppy. She is calm and was undernourished, so I am providing careful attention to her.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It’s awful how some people could treat such a tiny puppy so badly.
